entities.summary: Rachael Vanderwal is a 5'9 (1.75m) former point guard for Great Britain women's national basketball team. She was part of the squad for the 2012 Summer Olympics and part of the England squad that took silver at the 2018 Commonwealth Games. She has dual citizenship with Great Britain and Canada.
